name: Insulin A chain (human)
description: Endogenous hormone; A chain of human insulin (e.g. as in Humalog, Lantus formulations)

name: Insulin B chain (human)
description: Endogenous hormone; B chain of human insulin

name: Glucagon
description: Raises blood glucose; used as emergency injectable (GlucaGen) for severe hypoglycemia

name: GLP-1 (7-37 active form)
description: Native active incretin; structural basis for GLP-1 receptor agonist diabetes/obesity drugs

name: Exenatide (exendin-4 based)
description: Marketed as Byetta/Bydureon; synthetic analog of exendin-4 from Gila monster saliva, type 2 diabetes

name: Oxytocin
description: Uterine contraction / lactation / social bonding hormone; in vivo form is cyclic (Cys1-Cys6 disulfide) and C-terminally amidated - shown here as linear backbone only

name: Arginine vasopressin (ADH)
description: Antidiuretic hormone; basis for desmopressin (DDAVP), a diabetes insipidus drug. In vivo cyclic + C-term amidated, shown as linear backbone

name: Calcitonin (salmon)
description: Marketed as Miacalcin; more potent and longer-acting than human calcitonin at the same receptor

name: Teriparatide (PTH 1-34)
description: Recombinant fragment of human parathyroid hormone; marketed as Forteo

name: Angiotensin I
description: Inactive precursor cleaved to angiotensin II by ACE; ACE inhibitor drug target

name: Angiotensin II
description: Potent vasoconstrictor; target of ARB drugs (losartan class). NOTE: only 8 aa, shorter than k=9 - deliberately included to exercise the query-shorter-than-k edge case

name: Substance P
description: Pain/inflammation signaling via NK1 receptor; target of aprepitant-class antiemetic drugs

name: Bradykinin
description: Vasodilator/pain mediator; target of icatibant (Firazyr), a hereditary angioedema drug

name: Enfuvirtide
description: Marketed as Fuzeon; HIV-1 fusion inhibitor derived from the HR2 region of gp41

name: Bivalirudin
description: Marketed as Angiomax; direct thrombin inhibitor derived from hirudin (leech anticoagulant). First residue is D-phenylalanine in the real drug, shown here as standard F

name: Linaclotide
description: Marketed as Linzess; guanylate cyclase-C agonist, stabilized in vivo by 3 disulfide bonds

name: Pramlintide
description: Marketed as Symlin; synthetic analog of amylin, used as adjunct insulin therapy

name: LL-37
description: Human cathelicidin; innate immune defense peptide, active area of novel-antibiotic research

name: Melittin
description: Major lytic component of honeybee venom; widely used model membrane-disrupting peptide in AMP research

name: Magainin 2
description: Isolated from African clawed frog (Xenopus laevis) skin; template for novel antibiotic scaffolds

name: Self-match control (from O60271)
description: Fragment extracted directly from human proteome entry O60271 (positions 100-135); should produce an EXACT (0-mismatch) hit against that same protein - use to sanity-check any matcher implementation

name: Near-self control (from A0A8V8TLU0; 1 mismatch)
description: Derived from human proteome entry A0A8V8TLU0 (positions 60-99) with a single substituted residue at position 19 (D->A); should produce a 1-mismatch hit against that protein when max_mismatches=1 - use to sanity-check mismatch tolerance

name: Scrambled negative control
description: Arbitrary scrambled sequence not derived from any real biological source (includes non-standard letters X, Z, J to further reduce collision chance); should produce NO matches - use to sanity-check false-positive rate
